result.brief: 研究发现纯图像自监督训练的 DINOv3 视觉 Transformer 能在嵌入空间中按语义组织渲染文字，并与其命名物体类别表征对齐，为视觉表征学习提供新证据。
result.reason: DINOv3 self-supervised vision transformers show emergent word-meaning structure in embeddings, a direct visual representation-learning finding relevant to DINO-style self-supervised representation research.
